title: Make settings reachable and keyboard accessible at minimum size
verification: Production build and renderer TypeScript passed. Real Electron app entry reached all 24 tabs using ArrowDown plus Home/End at 800x600 and default 1280x800; each selected tab was fully within the scroll viewport. Mouse interaction, actual Light/Dark settings, Tab/Shift+Tab boundary wrapping and focus return to the Settings opener passed at both sizes. Graceful quit passed. Lint and both TypeScript projects run in the commit hook.
notes: Adds dialog/tab semantics, a labeled close control, constrained dimensions, scrolling and focus return; reuses the approval modal's focus-boundary approach. Live minimum-size testing found narrow side drawers intercepted settings clicks, so drawer/backdrop layers now sit below settings while approval modals retain priority. No new modal framework. SR-19 pushed at a0d6f9c7515a00ce77a4c6fed454d32dadf48e47; its GitHub CI and Pages passed, build still running when checked.
